name: Telemetry Code
description: Dictionary that maps a coded telemetry value to its meaning, e.g. vcu_fault_code 142 = 'Motor over-temperature'. Used to show the human meaning of a code in alerts. Bulk-load via Data Import (CSV) or edit by hand.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: The raw value as it appears in telemetry, e.g. 142.

fields.label: Meaning
fields.description: Short human meaning shown in the alert, e.g. 'Motor over-temperature'.

fields.label: Severity
fields.description: Optional. How serious this code is (for reference / future routing).

fields.label: Recommended Action
fields.description: Optional. What to do when this code appears.
